content.text:
I haven't approved DR-17.

The operator notice lets you approve discount requests only for the week of Monday 16 to Friday 20 November. Since Nikos left a day early, it sounds like that week hasn't started yet, and that cover doesn't stretch to cover his extra days away. Your Sales role doesn't let you approve requests on its own.

To get Thistlewick an answer before the weekend, ask Owen Hale (Finance, owen@ottermere.example). He can approve discount requests now. If it's already 16–20 November where you are, tell me and I'll approve DR-17.
